subject.title: improve(android): move Wear agent, session, and model pickers to Home

question: Should Wear OS permanently retire the separate Agent and Session pages in favor of Home controls, with model selection available only when the paired Phone advertises `model-controls`?
rationale: The branch is technically coherent and proof-positive, but the page-removal and paired-version UX are an intentional product contract rather than a mechanically provable bug fix.

options.title: Adopt the Home-first workflow
options.body: Approve the capability-gated Home controls and retire the two dedicated pages, accepting disabled model controls with older paired Phone builds.

options.title: Preserve separate context pages
options.body: Keep or restore dedicated Agent and Session navigation until a maintainer chooses a different Wear information architecture.

recommendation.title: Adopt the Home-first workflow
recommendation.body: Approve the capability-gated Home controls and retire the two dedicated pages, accepting disabled model controls with older paired Phone builds.
